patch_description:
This revision keeps the complete planning pipeline on the input tensor device, removing the unconditional CPU transfer and preserving output-device locality. It also avoids rebuilding ranks for the common non-refined packing path by recording ranks during LPT assignment.

For GPU placement, the refinement step now selects swaps whose transferred load is closest to half of the current heavy/light load gap. This minimizes the post-swap maximum load more effectively than selecting the largest valid transfer. Refinement remains bounded to small layouts and fixed rounds, avoiding host synchronization and keeping planning latency predictable.
